issue.title: tmux terminal smoke test fails with 'File name too long': TMUX_TMPDIR under tmp_path exceeds the Unix socket path limit
issue.description: Socket path length bug in the slow-lane tmux smoke test; see the CI failure body.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake:
Deterministic in agent workspaces, reproduced by the sase-18f land agent at master ae34dba20:
`.venv/bin/python -m pytest -m 'slow or not slow' tests/ace/tui/terminal_smoke/test_ace_terminal_smoke.py::test_sase_screenshot_cli_captures_png_with_tmux` fails in 2.9s with
`sase screenshot: failed to create 'sase_ace_agents' session: error connecting to /home/bryan/.cache/sase/tmp/agent-tmp/gh_sase-org__sase-ws0-260924_183207/pytest-of-bryan/pytest-4/test_sase_screenshot_cli_captu0/tmux/tmux-1000/default (File name too long)`.

Root cause: the test sets `TMUX_TMPDIR = tmp_path / "tmux"` (tests/ace/tui/terminal_smoke/test_ace_terminal_smoke.py:125-129). tmux puts its socket at `$TMUX_TMPDIR/tmux-<uid>/default`, and under the long agent basetemp that path is about 150 bytes, past the Unix-domain socket `sun_path` limit (108 bytes). Slow lane only, so `just check` does not select it.

Fix: create the tmux socket directory with a short `tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="sase-tmux-", dir="/tmp")` (cleaned up in a finalizer), or pass an explicit short `-S` socket path, instead of nesting it under `tmp_path`. Proposed by sase-18f.4 (PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP #5).

payload.description: Both break only under the long agent-workspace pytest basetemp; fix one path-length assumption each
